text_to_image_prompt: Photorealistic wardrobe product photograph. Pure white seamless background and soft neutral studio lighting. No person, skin, body parts, visible mannequin or stand. Entire objects visible, faithful texture. 折起的报纸搭配道具。仅此单件配饰，成对耳饰或手套作为一组，无其他物品。
original_prompt: Extract ONLY the folded newspaper from this reference image. Remove the entire black handbag including all handles, straps, buckles and chains. Display ONE folded newspaper alone, centered and enlarged, against a plain white background, with a slight natural shadow. Newspaper print may be abstract indistinct editorial columns. No handbag, no accessories, no clothing, no people.
reproduction_note: 依据用户附件制作白底无人商品图；原附件仅作参考。遮挡处、微小首饰和未展示结构采用保守补全，不代表品牌或精确商品鉴定。参考图中的文字与品牌标志不作为商品身份依据。
